Author: cloudesh
Name: Kupo Skribbl
Description:
Kupo Skribbl is a multiplayer Pictionary-style drawing and guessing game inside Final Fantasy XIV for 2–16 players. Take turns choosing a word and drawing it while everyone else guesses; the player with the most points wins. Includes private rooms, public lobbies, friends and custom drawn portraits. Everyone connects automatically to our shared server—no server setup required.

Open with /kupo, /kupopop or /kuposkribbl.
Punchline: A multiplayer Pictionary-style drawing game inside FFXIV.
